candidates.prompt: Create one candidate illustration for a Chinese language educational textbook slide cover, widescreen 16:9 composition. Subject: Sun Wu / Sun Tzu as a calm ancient Chinese military thinker in simple spring-and-autumn-period clothing, standing beside an open bamboo-slip manuscript and a folded silk map, with subtle abstract strategy elements such as a few small stones arranged like a planning board and a distant soft landscape. Make the composition balanced with generous quiet negative space for slide title placement, especially on the left, and the main figure and objects grouped toward the right-center. Approved textbook illustration style: fine blue-gray linework, delicate pencil and watercolor texture, low-saturation pastel slate blue, sage, muted sand, and a restrained coral accent, airy educational editorial illustration, gentle and approachable, historically inspired but not dramatic. The illustration itself must have a clean near-white background that can sit on a pure white PowerPoint canvas. No readable text, no Chinese characters, no Latin letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no flag, no military insignia, no speech bubbles, no photorealism, no weapons in use, no blood, no violence.

candidates.prompt: Create one candidate illustration for a Chinese language educational textbook slide, widescreen 16:9 composition. Short-text context: the worldwide influence of Sun Tzu's book. Show an open ancient manuscript resting in the foreground beside a softly painted globe, with delicate blue-gray curved paths radiating outward toward small, diverse groups of people in three calm settings: a modern university seminar, a bookstore with several blank book covers, and a business team studying a planning board. Suggest that the ideas travel from history into education and business, without making the scene commercial or political. Use abstract blank book pages and blank map shapes only, with no language-specific marks.
